travel.title: See you at Villa Valentina.
travel.carText: Set your navigation to Villa Valentina, Via Donizetti 17, Tradate (VA). Follow the directions (you can’t get lost), and once you arrive, you can park right at the villa.
travel.trainText: The Trenord Milano Cadorna–Saronno–Varese line, which works every now and then, stops at Tradate. Let us know in advance if you need a lift from the station to the villa!
travel.imageAlt: A random photo of Villa Valentina
